Context helper returning msg.sender.

block.timestamp: miner-influenced value used as randomness entropy in randomGen.
External call nftTicket.safeMint(_msgSender(), rewardTicketId[i], 1) executed inside the claim-facing loop.
Reward selection depends on block.timestamp/blockhash, so a miner/attacker can bias the draw.
Logic flaw: lootIsClaimed reads xlootClaimedBitMap, so loot claims are validated against the wrong bitmap.
claimLeft and rewardTicketLeft[i] are decremented in _drawTicket (checked arithmetic in ^0.8.0).
